messages:
chee: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 1 posting a few manager questions here so we have a written record.
maria: Thanks @chee 1 I'll answer succinctly and link docs.
devin: Two quick ones: 1) If a promotion is approved mid-cycle, when does compensation update? 2) Any guidance for managers when a candidate relocates (band changes)?
maria: 1) Comp/title goes to payroll on the next run unless approved before cutoff. Retro pay only in material cases. 2) Relocations: submit location-change form; Comp team re-evaluates band placement. See comp doc for LOC table.
sasha: Appeals timeline? Someone asked about escalation to avoid manager conflict.
maria: Appeals: manager -> People Ops (30 days to file) -> expedited review target 30 days. For potential bias escalate to independent reviewers (Comp + cross-func). We keep confidentiality to the extent possible.
hr-bot: Links: <https://company-notion/people-ops/comp-cycles|Comp cycles>  <https://company-notion/people-ops/appeals|Appeals process>
chee: Can we get a short canned script for managers to explain denials? That was popular in the Q&A.
maria: Yes 1 adding a "denial + next steps" script to the manager toolkit by Friday. Short example: "Thanks for your work. After calibration we couldn't approve this cycle because X. Here's a 90-day plan with measurable milestones."
devin: Perfect. Can you cc managers when the template is live?
maria: Will do. I'll also start a weekly digest for pending promos so nothing falls through Slack.
chee: Thanks all 1 will paste these notes into the all-hands follow-up doc.
